hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 read by esptool

inputs.name: Vendor application screen labels reported before ROM entry
Official esptool standalone macOS arm64 archive

scenario: Enter ROM Download Mode with BOOT held at power-on. Read chip/security information and NOR identity without a stub. Read the complete NOR using the official RAM stub. After manual ROM re-entry, verify the saved file against flash using ROM verify-flash. Parse the ESP-IDF partition table and check its MD5. No flash/eFuse write or erase command was issued.
expected: USB ROM access, a complete private NOR backup matching the device, and an internally consistent installed partition table.
observed: USB enumerated as ESP32-S31 with a CDC serial port on macOS arm64. Chip revision 0.0, 40 MHz crystal, USB-OTG mode; NOR JEDEC manufacturer 0xc8, device 0x4018, detected 16 MB. Secure Boot and Flash Encryption disabled on this sample. Read 16777216 bytes; ROM verify-flash reported a matching digest. Partition table at 0x9000 has a valid MD5 and nvs, otadata, phy_init, factory, ui_apps and system entries; no vibe_mode or OTA app slot.
limits: This establishes vendor ROM access and NOR backup verification, not EmberBSD boot, an installed image or a tested restore.
The board revision is an operator report; silicon revision is separate. BaseBoard marking was not independently read.
NOR contents and device identifiers are private and are not attached. The separate NAND, eFuses and off-device data are not covered by this backup.
Security settings and partition offsets apply to the observed firmware/sample, not every Mosaico or software release.
The USB device disappeared after the stub read; cause was not established. Manual ROM re-entry restored access and ROM verification succeeded.
UART, RAM-only OS boot and the vendor Vibe update path were not exercised.
